findings.summary: Deferred signals are re-queued behind later arrivals, which breaks arrival order.
An action for an unknown task is dropped without a rejected record.
extend_15_days is unlimited when the task has no request_id ref.
A reason made only of whitespace passes the reason_required check.
dismiss_finding accepts a finding_id that is not among the task's finding evidence refs.
Permanent Mongo errors (DuplicateKeyError, a validator WriteError) are retryable, so they loop hourly instead of holding the case. Intentionally deferred.
alongside uses asyncio.wait, which the SDK documents as non-deterministic (it uses sets). It is safe only because the result is not iterated. Use workflow.wait instead.

finally cancels the loop and main tasks without awaiting them, so on a workflow cancel or host error the run finishes before the children run their cancellation or cleanup. Await them after cancelling, and document that hosts must return only when review.idle.
